module: Career save system. Profiles are folders of settings/cloud/saves/<profile>/; each save is a subfolder (autosave1 to autosave4 in rotation, or a chosen name) containing info.json (version, UTC date, creationDate, displayName, corrupted). saveCurrent first writes info.json as "corrupted", triggers the onSaveCurrentProfileAsyncStart then onSaveCurrentProfile(path, thumbnails) hooks so that each extension writes its files, waits for asynchronous extensions, then finalizes info.json and emits onSaveFinished.
usage:
-- in a career extension
function M.onSaveCurrentProfile(currentSavePath)
  career_saveSystem.jsonWriteFileSafe(currentSavePath .. "/career/monModule.json", data, true)
end
notes: Format version: saveSystemVersion = 64; saves whose version is lower than backwardsCompVersion (36) are refused by setProfile (returns false).
Four autosaves: getOldestAutosave picks the first missing one, otherwise the oldest by date.
For an asynchronous extension: registerAsyncSaveExtension(name) during onSaveCurrentProfile, then asyncSaveExtensionFinished(name) when done; the save finalizes when all are done.
jsonWriteFileSafe writes to a .tmp file then renames; on failure, it calls saveFailed() (which clears infoData, so the save will be reported as failed) and returns false.
Profile names created without an existing info.json are sanitized (lowercase alphanumeric, numeric suffix if already taken); the display name keeps the original name.
removeProfile and renameProfile do nothing (return nil) for the current profile when the career is active; renameProfile returns nil if the folder rename fails.
onSerialize / onDeserialized keep the current profile across a Lua reload.

getAllSaveFolders.desc: Lists a profile's saves (content of info.json + name field = folder name), sorted by ascending date.

getNewestSave.desc: Finds the most recent (non-corrupted) save folder of a profile path.

returns.desc: Folder path, or empty string if none.

setProfile.desc: Selects the current profile (and its most recent save or a specific one). Emits onBeforeSetProfile then onSetProfile(savePath, profile). With profile = nil, deselects.

specificSaveFolder.desc: Name of a specific save subfolder.

returns.desc: false if profile is nil or the save is too old, true otherwise.

removeProfile.desc: Deletes a profile's folder (refused for the current profile if the career is active).

removeSaveFolder.desc: Deletes a profile's save folder, except the current save or an illegal name.

renameProfile.desc: Renames a profile's folder (refused if the new name exists, or for the current profile in an active career).

returns.desc: true if renamed, false if refused, nil in other failure cases.

getCurrentProfile.desc: Returns the current profile and the path of its current save.

returns.desc: Path of the current save folder (to use as the root of the career files).

getCurrentDisplayName.desc: Display name of the current profile.

saveCurrent.desc: Saves the career into an autosave (the oldest) or into saveName. Without a current profile, does nothing.

vehiclesThumbnailUpdate.desc: Passed to extensions via onSaveCurrentProfile (e.g. list of inventoryIds whose thumbnail must be updated).

saveName.desc: Name of a dedicated save instead of an autosave.

saveFailed.desc: Marks the current save as failed (clears infoData).

jsonWriteFileSafe.desc: Writes a JSON via a temporary file then renames (atomic write).

registerAsyncSaveExtension.desc: Declares that an extension will finish its save later (finalization is delayed).

asyncSaveExtensionFinished.desc: Signals that an asynchronous extension has finished; finalizes the save when all are done.

getAllProfiles.desc: Lists the profile names (folders of settings/cloud/saves/).

onSerialize.desc: Lua reload hook: returns the current profile, path, display name and creation date.

onDeserialized.desc: Lua reload hook: restores the state returned by onSerialize.
